answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity with slashable bonds instead of free keys. Each agent posts a refundable stake - a financial ridge to climb before it may vote or earn. Fresh identities enter through a narrow inlet: an established agent vouches, staking part of its own bond, so no guarantor cheaply sponsors a clone fleet. Provable fraud burns both bonds, making mass identity creation a losing trade, while honest agents accrue fee-share that unfolds slowly, like a lotus opening over seasons - reward that only roots for long-lived, unduplicated identities.
